The plugin now restores compatibility with older versions of the app by reinstating legacy storage and interface permissions, ensuring titlebar buttons can be customized and hidden properly.

other: 插件不再申请非必要的存储与界面访问权限，精简了运行所需的权限范围。

The plugin details now reflect the updated author information and repository link under the new organization.
插件在插件市场中现已归入「外观」分类。
The plugin is now listed under the Appearance category in the plugin marketplace.

summary.zh: 为笔记铺上与行高对齐的点阵或方格，增加对比度，稳定追踪每一行
summary.en: Line-aligned dot or grid background for notes, adding contrast to track each line

storage.zh: 保存背景样式、对比度与对齐方式设置
storage.en: Save editor background style, contrast, and alignment preferences

ui:settings.zh: 应用并切换编辑器点阵或方格背景
ui:settings.en: Apply and toggle editor dot or grid backgrounds

fixes: 插件恢复了旧版本宿主应用所需的存储与界面权限，解决了旧版本环境下背景设置与控制界面无法正常加载或保存的问题。
The plugin restores storage and interface permissions on older versions of the host application, resolving issues where background settings and controls failed to load or save.

other: 插件不再申请存储与用户界面的豁免权限，精简了安装与运行所需的系统授权范围。
The plugin no longer requests exempt storage and user interface permissions, reducing the access privileges required during installation and operation.
插件信息中的作者与代码仓库链接已更新为新的官方组织。
The plugin author and repository links have been updated to the official organization.

This is a maintenance release with no user-facing changes.

summary.zh: 官方全扩展点示范插件：覆盖顶栏、侧栏、文件树角标、编辑区背景、面板、菜单、状态栏与弹窗
summary.en: Official kitchen-sink demo covering titlebar, sidebar sections, file badges, editor backdrops, panels, menus, status bar, and dialogs

storage.zh: 保存拉屎风格、背景参数、笔记本白名单与战况记录。
storage.en: Save style preferences, backdrop settings, notebook allowlist, and drop history.

notes:read.zh: 扫描笔记中的标记数量、展示统计并支持点击列表打开对应笔记。
notes:read.en: Scan notes for drop markers, compute stats, and jump to notes from lists.

notes:write.zh: 向笔记写入可识别标记并在冲水时精确清理插件留下的标记行。
notes:write.en: Insert identifiable drop markers into notes and cleanly remove them on flush.

events:note_saved.zh: 保存笔记后自动重算该页标记数并刷新文件树角标与状态栏。
events:note_saved.en: Recount drop markers after note saves and refresh file badges and status bar.

ui:titlebar.zh: 在顶栏挂载面板、快捷拉一坨与冲水按钮，并动态展示数量角标。
ui:titlebar.en: Mount panel, quick-drop, and flush buttons in the titlebar with live badges.

ui:commands.zh: 向命令面板、默认快捷键、页面「…」菜单与编辑器右键菜单注册操作。
ui:commands.en: Register commands, default shortcuts, page menu items, and editor menu items.

ui:panels.zh: 在右侧打开「屎量面板」展示实时统计、战报与快捷操作。
ui:panels.en: Open the right-hand Poop Board side panel for live metrics and actions.

ui:status.zh: 在底部状态栏展示带图标的当前总数，点击可一键切换右侧面板。
ui:status.en: Display a live icon counter in the bottom status bar to toggle the board.

ui:notify.zh: 弹出四类语气带图标轻提示，并在冲水前打开二次确认弹窗。
ui:notify.en: Show icon-bearing toasts across all tones and open a flush confirmation dialog.

ui:sidebar.zh: 在左侧栏挂载「今日屎迹」分区、文件树行尾角标与笔记右键菜单。
ui:sidebar.en: Add Today's Drops sidebar section, file-tree row badges, and tree context actions.

ui:appearance.zh: 在编辑区背景层绘制可调图案、密度与暗色夜光效果的矢量水印。
ui:appearance.en: Render configurable vector patterns, watermarks, and dark-glow editor backdrops.

editor:read.zh: 读取当前编辑器选中文本，以便将其包装成带附言的标记块。
editor:read.en: Read the active editor selection to wrap selected text into a marked block.

editor:write.zh: 在当前光标处插入标记块，或直接替换选中的正文内容。
editor:write.en: Insert marked blocks at the caret or replace the active editor selection.

events:workspace.zh: 监听笔记切换、深浅色主题与语言变化事件并同步界面状态。
events:workspace.en: React to note open, theme change, and locale change workspace events.

fixes: 恢复了对旧版本宿主应用的存储与界面权限支持，确保各项界面组件与本地数据在较早版本的客户端中均能正常使用。
The plugin now restores legacy storage and interface permissions, ensuring that all UI elements and saved data function reliably on older versions of the host application.

improvements: 右上角的通知横幅现已改为显示插件默认图标。
other: 插件不再申请存储与界面的豁免权限，缩减了运行所需的权限范围。

improvements: Notification banners in the top-right corner now display the default plugin icon.
other: The plugin no longer requests exempt storage and user interface permissions, reducing the required access scope.

feat: remove appearance settings section and ui:settings permission (`56e9cea`)

summary.zh: 午夜铜版塔罗皮肤与写作仪式：牌桌三张牌阵、每日一牌反问、大阿卡纳牌册与速记换肤

ui:titlebar.en: Show the Tarot Mode moon toggle button in the titlebar

ui:commands.zh: 向命令面板注册切换塔罗模式与打开各仪式房间的快捷命令
ui:commands.en: Register command palette actions for Tarot Mode and ritual rooms

ui:notify.zh: 切换塔罗模式或进入仪式房间时显示状态提示
ui:notify.en: Show status feedback when toggling Tarot Mode or opening ritual rooms

events:workspace.zh: 监听语言与主题切换事件，同步更新顶栏按钮与界面状态

Tarot Mode now reinstates legacy storage and interface permissions, restoring normal operation and data saving on older versions of the host application.

improvements: 塔罗模式现在请求的权限更少，移除了豁免的存储权限和界面访问权限。

other: 插件详情中的作者署名与源码仓库链接现已更新至官方插件组织。
The plugin details now point to the official plugin organization for author attribution and source code repository links.
插件的发版说明配置已更新。

summary.zh: 为侧栏笔记和文件夹更换 96 款双色矢量图标，支持 7 种柔和色调与标签页同步显示
summary.en: Customize sidebar notes and folders with 96 two-tone icons, 7 soft tints, and optional tab sync

storage.zh: 保存图标选择器的交互开关与标签页同步偏好设置

summary.zh: 支持本地目录镜像、WebDAV 与 Git 仓库的多端增量同步
summary.en: Incremental notebook sync via local mirror, WebDAV, and Git

storage.zh: 保存各笔记本的同步配置、同步状态元信息与近期同步日志
storage.en: Save per-notebook sync settings, sync state metadata, and recent logs

notes:read.zh: 读取待同步笔记与附件内容，用于增量比对与上传

notes:write.zh: 将远端拉取的新增或更新笔记、冲突副本写入本地工作区，并把远端已删除的未改动文件移入回收站
notes:write.en: Write remote note updates and conflict copies locally, and move files deleted remotely and unchanged locally to the Trash

network.zh: 连接 WebDAV 服务器或远程 Git 仓库执行双向同步
network.en: Connect to WebDAV servers or remote Git repositories for sync

events:note_saved.zh: 在笔记保存后自动触发增量同步
events:note_saved.en: Automatically trigger incremental sync when a note is saved

system:notify.zh: 同步失败、发生冲突或需要确认时发出通知
system:notify.en: Notify you when sync fails, encounters conflicts, or needs confirmation

system:secrets.zh: 将 Git 令牌和 WebDAV 密码保存在系统凭据库中
system:secrets.en: Store Git tokens and WebDAV passwords in the system credential store

events:system.zh: 系统唤醒或恢复联网后按现有规则补做自动同步
events:system.en: Resume automatic sync after waking or reconnecting, using the existing sync rules

fixes: 同步功能现在会在删除单篇笔记或整个文件夹时记录删除标记，确保删除操作能够可靠地同步到所有设备，避免已删除的内容重新出现。
Sync now records deletion markers when individual notes or entire folders are removed, ensuring that deletions are reliably propagated across all devices instead of removed content reappearing.
恢复了对旧版本宿主应用的存储与界面权限支持，确保在旧版本客户端中可以正常访问本地数据并显示插件界面。
Sync restores required storage and interface permissions for older versions of the host application, ensuring local data access and interface controls work properly.

new: 同步通知现已采用应用右上角横幅的形式展示，并提供直达插件设置的快捷入口。
other: 插件移除了多余的存储与通知权限申请，进一步精简了运行所需的系统权限。

new: Sync now displays notifications as an in-app banner in the top-right corner, complete with a direct shortcut to plugin settings.
other: The plugin no longer requests unnecessary storage and notification permissions, reducing the access privileges required to run.

new: 同步现在会将删除操作传播到本地目录、镜像目录、Git 仓库和 WebDAV 目标。
同步现在会将同步活动记录到 Block 的活动日志中。
fixes: 保存配置时，同步现在会阻止关闭唯一启用的目标。
other: 同步在商店中的分类现为「工具」。

new: Sync now propagates deletions across local folders, mirror directories, Git repositories, and WebDAV targets.
Sync now records its activity in Block’s activity log.
fixes: Sync now prevents you from disabling the only enabled target when saving its configuration.
other: Sync’s store listing is now classified under Tools.

fixes: 对于尚未完成配置的同步目标，同步界面不再显示最近同步活动卡片。
Sync now hides the recent sync activity card for sync targets that have not been configured.

summary.zh: 支持 Cloudflare R2、S3 兼容存储与 GitHub 仓库的笔记图片自动上传

events:note_saved.zh: 在保存笔记时自动检测并上传其中的本地图片

system:clipboard_read.zh: 点击菜单栏「上传剪贴板」时读取剪贴板中的图片或图片文件
system:clipboard_read.en: Read clipboard images or image files when clicking Upload Clipboard in the menu bar

system:clipboard_write.zh: 上传完成或点击最近记录时将远程图片链接写入剪贴板

ui:menubar.zh: 在系统菜单栏显示上传图标，接收拖入或剪贴板图片并列出最近上传
ui:menubar.en: Show a menu bar icon to upload dropped or clipboard images and list recent uploads

ui:commands.zh: 注册上传剪贴板、上传拖入文件与复制最近链接命令

The plugin now properly declares clipboard permissions to prevent operation failures and restores compatibility with older versions of the note application.

new: 将图片拖到菜单栏图标上或粘贴到图标处即可上传，上传后会自动复制图片链接。
图片上传结果现在会通过应用内右上角横幅通知显示。
other: 插件现在申请的存储和界面相关权限更少。
